title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — September 18, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B3.2 (Peaked September 17, 2026 at 12:16 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 430 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Looks pretty quiet right now. ☀🖤

A broad coronal-hole-like region is visible on the Sun’s lower-left side, while the disk appears largely spotless and the surrounding corona looks quiet.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
